planApproval.note: While 'required', /plan-issue stops after posting every plan. After graduation to 'auto', plans for issues carrying any label in alwaysRequiredFor STILL stop for user approval — ADRs are major decisions and the user steers at this altitude. Graduation is proposed via retro PR; the user decides.

merge.autoRule: A PR auto-merges once CI is green iff it contains NO source-code files AND touches nothing under humanAlways paths. Source code = extensions .ts .tsx .js .mjs .cjs .sh .py .tf .sql — files whose structure (functions, modules, components) the user reviews. Markdown, JSON, YAML, and other plain config auto-merge.
merge.codeRule: Human-review PRs: CI green, then label 'awaiting-review', notify the user with a short review guide, do NOT merge; continue with independent tickets while it waits.
merge.note: Propose relaxing via retro PR once review-feedback categories go quiet — the user decides.
